title: Lab self-test
tagline: Synthetic events that exercise every part of the lab UI
pattern: Platform self-test; no real systems are involved and every number is simulated

metrics.label: Write rate (simulated)
metrics.howMeasured: Simulated: base rate ramped over 10 s, times 10 during a burst

metrics.label: Write p99 (simulated)
metrics.howMeasured: Simulated: nearest-rank p99 over one tick of generated latency samples

metrics.label: Rows stored (simulated)
metrics.howMeasured: Simulated: cumulative sum of write-rate ticks

phases.label: Warm up
phases.narration: The generator ramps up while every component reports healthy.

phases.label: Steady state
phases.narration: Rows flow end to end at a steady rate with flat latency.

phases.label: Burst
phases.narration: A burst multiplies the write rate by ten; watch latency stay under target.

phases.label: Verify
phases.narration: The run stops and the counts check proves nothing was lost.

controls.label: Burst x10
controls.description: Multiply the simulated write rate by ten for ten seconds
